title: Absolutely gorgeous but leaks
text: Absolutely gorgeous but leaks. I must agree with others about the lack of instructions. I watched a video from someone who purchased it and showed how to assemble it. It helped way more than the instructions. It is absolutely gorgeous and I love it so much. Having said that, I am so thankful that I left it on my kitchen counter because there was a tremendous amount of water that splashed out from everywhere. It took 2 kitchen towels to wipe up all of the water. The instructions said to fill it until the pump was submerged. That’s exactly what I did. The water was splashing out from the crystal ball, the mist was spewing out and the water was splashing out as it fell from the waterfalls into the pond area. I took out quite a bit of water but it was still soaking everything around it. I continued taking it out until the pump was submerged about half way. The ball was no longer rotating and the waterfall was a trickle. It finally stopped leaking. A couple of minutes later, the atomizer stopped rotating and began flashing red lights only. I quickly added a little bit of water and it began working again. I’m not sure how I will correct this problem just yet but I will figure out a way. It is just so beautiful but not worth ruining a nice piece of furniture for. Does anyone have any suggestions? I thought about buying one of those plastic things that you put under plants but that won’t correct the misting and it would probably need to be emptied daily. Other ideas would be greatly appreciated.
